title: Heesen Yacht Finance
metaDescription: Silver Oak Capital arranged $14m yacht finance at 60% LTV for a 50m Heesen yacht, with a 10-year term and tailored lending for a luxury acquisition.
summary: Case study of a yacht acquisition loan. Amount: $14 million (US dollars). Asset: a 50-metre Heesen yacht. Leverage: 60% loan-to-value. Borrower: described as a wealthy individual (result [a]) / a wealthy Chinese national (result [b]) who wanted long-term financing and needed to buy the boat quickly. Structure: 4.25% margin over SONIA, 10-year term, repayments amortised over a 20-year profile, 2.75% lender fee. Challenge: the team had to address the yacht's valuation, its maintenance costs, regulatory compliance for maritime operations, and whether the yacht suited the buyer's preferences. Outcome: the $14m facility was arranged on the terms above. Lender identity/type, yacht location or flag, exact dates and timing to completion were not revealed by the search results.
